title: Identify groundwater vulnerable areas that need protection
method: Project mc_soils to NAD83 / Oregon North LCC (EPSG:32126, the CRS of land_cover.tif). Rasterise drclassdcd (codes 1-5 in ArcGIS order of appearance: Well, Poorly, Somewhat excessively, Excessively, Somewhat poorly) and wdepannmin on the 30 m land_cover grid within the mc_boundary extent (cell-centre rule). Reclassify drainage 1->3, 2->1, 3->4, 4->5, 5->2 (= Excessively 5 ... Poorly 1) and depth 0-10->5, 10-33->4, 33-61->3, 61-80->2, 80-92->1 (upper bound inclusive). vulnerable = 5*drain + 4*depth, rescaled linearly to [1,10]; risk = 8*vulnerable + 10*reclassified NLCD; keep the 8 undeveloped NLCD classes where risk > 100. Result: 665 cells (0.60 km2; Hay/Pasture 601, Barren 62, Shrub/Scrub 2). risk_zones.tif is also written.

key_parameters.drainage_codes: order of appearance = stated in the task (1 Well, 2 Poorly, 3 Somewhat excessively, 4 Excessively, 5 Somewhat poorly); alphabetical not accepted
key_parameters.standardisation: linear 1 + 9*(v-min)/(max-min), not rounded (stated in the task); 10 classes / rounding not accepted

benchmark_defects: The published instruction asks for 'output/undeveloped_areas.tif'; the benchmark convention is pred_results/, which is used.

The published drainage reclass table refers to codes 1-5 without saying which drainage string each code is; ArcGIS assigns them in order of appearance (which makes the table monotone in drainage rate), np.unique/sorted gives alphabetical codes - the result differs completely.
wdepannmin takes exactly the break values 10, 33, 61, 80, so the inclusive side of each reclass range decides the class of thousands of polygons.
'Standardization to [1, 10]' in the published instruction is ambiguous (linear rescale vs 10 classes).
Because risk > 100 for undeveloped land is reached only at a few exact score combinations, these ambiguities change the answer from 102 to 103 000 cells (mutual IoU 0.006-0.17).

land_cover.tif carries an ESRI header that rasterio reads as LOCAL_CS 'NAD83 / Oregon North', so soils.to_crs(land_cover.crs) fails; a solution must recognise EPSG:32126. An unmentioned Albers copy mc_land_cover.tif is also present.

The task text used here states the drainage coding, the continuous (not rounded) standardisation and the output path pred_results/undeveloped_areas.tif; the checks accept 2 interpretations (depth-bound variants), the same standard as tasks 26 and 27.
checks: required: georeferenced raster with >= 1 selected (valid, non-zero) cell

required: selected cells, mapped onto the land_cover grid (reprojected if needed), match one of the 2 accepted interpretations (depth bounds upper- or lower-inclusive) with 1-cell tolerance: precision >= 0.85 and recall >= 0.85
required: soils projected to Lambert Conformal Conic as prescribed: captured soils layer or deliverable raster in an LCC CRS
optional: selected cells carry undeveloped NLCD codes or a 0/1 mask
